sloka: संह्रादिः प्रघसश्चैव भासकर्णश्च राक्षसः ।राका पुष्पोत्कटा चैव कैकसी च शुचिस्मिता ॥
transliteration: saṁhrādiḥ praghasaścaiva bhāsakarṇaśca rākṣasaḥ ।rākā puṣpotkaṭā caiva kaikasī ca śucismitā ॥

translations.english: The demon's other offspring were Samhradi, Praghasa, Bhasakarna, Raka, Pushpotkata, Kaikasi of the pure smile, and Kumbhinasi, all known as Sumali's progeny.
